reason: Net-additive bug fix: worker.py::SpeculativeMergeWorker._void_and_remerge records the adoption-voided verdict's own merge commit as a dead base (one guarded _record_dead_base call plus docstring site-list edits), so a depth-2 follower stacked on it with no host at void time is re-merged at dispatch instead of verifying on an orphaned base and paying a gate re-verify (task 7352, review-6273 finding). Not a refactor that failed.
